item.title: Zürich Airport deploys L4 autonomous shuttle – WITHOUT a human monitor
item.description: Zürich Airport has deployed not one but two fully automated electric shuttle buses on the grounds of Zürich Airport. Crucially, these self-driving vehicles are operating without a human safety monitor, making Zürich one of the first airports in Europe to test L4 autonomy in a live environment. more…
